tags.chapter_name: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

question.text: Which of the following statement is wrong?

options.text: Single $\mathrm{N}-\mathrm{N}$ bond is weaker than the single $\mathrm{P}-\mathrm{P}$ bond,
The stability of hydrides increases from $\mathrm{NH}_3$ to $\mathrm{BiH}_3$ in group 15 of the periodic table

solution.text: Stability of hydrides decreases down the group from $\mathrm{NH}_3$ to $\mathrm{BiH}_3$ as $\mathrm{M}-\mathrm{H}$ bond energy decreases.
